dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the division operation carried by a divisive inverse monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the real division used in the quotient x^2 / 2.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the heterogeneous division operation supplied by an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the quotient of the real number x^2 by the real number 2.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the heterogeneous power operation supplied by an HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms x raised to the natural-number exponent 2.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the conclusion the inequality cosh(x) less than or equal to exp(x^2 / 2), with that direction preserved.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds natural-number exponentiation on a monoid by repeated monoid multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives x^2 its ordinary natural-power meaning in the multiplicative monoid of real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Is the type of the exponent 2 and of the numeral indices used to construct the real denominator 2.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Shows that a natural number expressed as a nonzero natural plus one is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the at-least-two evidence required to interpret the denominator numeral 2 as a real number; it adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides evidence that a successor natural number is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the typeclass construction showing that the numeral 2 is at least two; it adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal in a type equipped with the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the literal 2 both as the natural exponent and as the real denominator, with auxiliary natural literals used only for instance construction.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies that x is universally quantified over all real numbers and that both sides of the inequality are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.cosh
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real hyperbolic cosine function, defined as the real part of the complex hyperbolic cosine on a real input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Produces the left-hand side cosh(x) of the inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.exp
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real exponential function, defined as the real part of the complex exponential on a real input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Produces the right-hand side exp(x^2 / 2) of the inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard divisive inverse monoid structure on the real numbers, whose division is multiplication by an inverse.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies ordinary real-number division for the constant factor x^2 / 2.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard less-than-or-equal relation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the comparison as the usual real inequality cosh(x) <= exp(x^2 / 2).

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplicative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies real multiplication and the unit underlying the natural power x^2.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard casting of natural numbers into the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Turns the natural numeral 2 into the real denominator 2.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts an ordinary same-type division operation to a homogeneous instance of heterogeneous division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Allows the real division operation to be invoked as x^2 / 2 in the elaborated target.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a power operation to a heterogeneous-power instance with the same base and result type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Allows natural-number exponentiation of the real base x to be invoked as x^2.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs an OfNat instance for numerals at least two from a natural-number cast operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constructs the real numeral 2 in the denominator from the standard natural-to-real cast.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets every natural-number literal as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constructs the natural exponent 2 and the auxiliary natural literals used in the denominator's numeral-instance evidence.

binders: x is an arbitrary real number.
conclusions: The real hyperbolic cosine of x is less than or equal to the real exponential of x squared divided by 2: cosh(x) <= exp(x^2 / 2).
mathematical_definitions: x^2 is the natural-number square of x using ordinary real multiplication.
The denominator 2 is the real number obtained from the natural numeral 2.
cosh and exp are the standard real hyperbolic cosine and real exponential functions.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every real number x, cosh(x) is at most exp(x^2 / 2).

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: There are no hypotheses or domain restrictions beyond x being real; the assertion is unconditional for every real x.
The divisor is the fixed real number 2, and the target does not introduce a variable-denominator or nonzero-denominator assumption.
No equality cases, strict inequality, optimality claim, probabilistic interpretation, or surrounding contextual claim is encoded.
There is no apparent vacuity risk: the proposition directly asserts an inequality for every real input.
